questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign tells you a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads divided by a median or guide rail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare you for upcoming road hazards. This sign warns of a T intersection ahead where you may need to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show rules you must follow. A red circle with a red slash means the action is prohibited. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals are used instead of turn signals. When the left arm is bent upward at the elbow, it means the rider plans to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs control traffic speed and movement. This sign shows the direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. Only buses and vehicles with the required number of passengers are allowed to use it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When driving on a multi-lane road, make space for vehicles entering the road. Move to another lane if no one is next to you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals are used to communicate when riding in groups. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a road is intersecting ahead from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has three or more curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead becomes a divided highway. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare you for road hazards. This sign warns you that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare you for road hazards. This sign warns you about a steep hill ahead. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid collisions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a pedestrian crossing. Watch for people entering the crosswalk or crossing in front of you. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you see this sign, you are driving the wrong way. This puts you at risk of a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that an upcoming bridge may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck. Drive with care.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a traffic signal is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the right lane is ending. Traffic in the right lane must move left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the fastest legal speed you can drive on this road. In bad weather like rain, snow, or ice, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular traffic signs warn of railroad crossings ahead. This sign tells you a train crossing is coming. Watch for signs of an approaching train.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane will end soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
That due to upcoming roadwork, detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the road will make a sharp turn ahead, in this case to the right. Slow down before you reach this sharp curve, just as you would at a turn in an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you a curve in the road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a lane reserved only for left-turning vehicles from either direction. You cannot use this lane for passing or driving straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals to show your intentions. When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing downward, it means the rider is slowing down or stopping.
